propositions: Four hand-built LLM sub-call sites pass config=cfg without declaring a model class, causing them to inherit cfg.model and bypass model-class configuration, routing to direct Anthropic instead of configured Bedrock.
overlap-judge dominates plan-review traffic with 18 of 23 calls, all routed to direct Anthropic when model classes are configured for Bedrock but cfg.model is left on bare-anthropic.

ticket-digest runs on the store write path via enrich_drain.maybe_drain, sending ticket content to direct Anthropic during routine rebar comment/create operations with no gate invocation to reveal it.

A model-class regression test must configure classes distinctly from cfg.model to distinguish between 'honours the class' and 'inherits cfg.model', otherwise both resolve to the same default and prove nothing.

Three of the four bypass sites (ticket-digest, overlap-judge, code-novelty) should be fixed to select from the class vocabulary; the fourth (review_ticket) is a top-level op's primary call where cfg.model is the correct operator knob.
